growth.adds: The task, ten project questions and a shortlist of models.
A LangChain assistant with conversation, streaming, structured output, tools, retries and tracing.
A versioned system prompt and a prompt test set.
A RAG pipeline with citations, advanced retrieval patterns, evals, regression tests and security tests.
An agent with tools, an MCP server, memory, approval gates, a sandbox, agent evals and attacks.
An API, a frontend, deployment, a CI gate, monitoring, caching, an optional fine-tune and a security review.

afterDay100.intro: The roadmap suggests two or three projects that each show a different skill, built to the same standard as the course project: a baseline, a test set of 30 or more cases, a security pass, a live link and a short demo video.

items.title: Invoice and Receipt Extractor
items.summary: Reads scanned bills, pulls out the fields, checks the arithmetic and sends doubtful ones to a person.

items.title: Data Question Answerer
items.summary: Answers plain-language questions about a dataset with read-only SQL, and shows the query behind each answer.

items.title: Research Agent with Cited Reports
items.summary: Researches sub-questions in parallel and writes a report where every claim links to a source that was checked.

items.title: Codebase Assistant
items.summary: Answers questions about a repository and proposes fixes that are verified by running tests in a sandbox.

items.title: Voice Booking Agent
items.summary: Books, changes and cancels appointments by voice, in English and mixed Hindi-English.

items.title: Contract and Policy Comparer
items.summary: Compares two versions of a contract and explains what changed, with citations into both.

items.title: Visual Product Search
items.summary: Finds catalog items from a photo, a description, or both together.

items.title: Browser Task Agent
items.summary: Completes multi-step tasks on real websites and asks for approval before anything that commits.

items.title: Fine-Tuned Small Model
items.summary: A small LoRA-tuned model that matches a large prompted model on one narrow task at a lower cost.

items.title: Published MCP Server
items.summary: An MCP server for a public API, released so other people can connect it to their own AI apps.

items.title: Personal Knowledge Agent
items.summary: Remembers and connects your notes over time, and lets you see, edit and delete what it remembers.

items.title: Cost-Cutting Model Gateway
items.summary: Sits in front of several model providers and cuts cost with caching, routing and failover, with a usage dashboard.
